args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

Quick note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" and should be relabelled to Pellow Home Living.
- "PHL" is shared with Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal), so check the org ID before running bulk seat audits or other bulk actions on PHL.

Sofia Marchetti (Coastal team) is the account manager on this. This draft was prepared by assistant for Sofia to review and send.
